sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 34 points from 16 games, face New Mills away on Saturday 14 November in The Edward Case Cup 2 S at 15:00. The leaders arrive on the back of a win and are in strong form, having won three of their last five league matches. New Mills come into the tie having lost their last two outings and will be looking to upset the leaders at home.
divisionWide: Saturday 14 November sees a full programme of fixtures across the division. Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, level on points with Sandbach but with a game in hand, do not appear in this week's fixtures. Third-ranked Eccleshall travel to Bilston Town in an important clash between mid-table contenders; Eccleshall are in excellent form with four consecutive league wins, while Bilston have picked up their form recently with three wins in their last six. Allscott Heath host Dawley Town in a matchup between sides in the upper-mid-table, with Allscott on a four-game winning streak. Brereton Social face Crewe at home; Crewe have been inconsistent and sit bottom-half, while Brereton are in the relegation zone. Foley Meir host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two struggling sides near the bottom. Telford Town, among the division's lowest performers, welcome Cheadle Heath Nomads. Wednesfield Community host Widnes Town, another contest involving two sides fighting near the bottom of the table. On Tuesday 17 November, AFC Bridgnorth travel to Shawbury United; Bridgnorth are in excellent form sitting fourth, while Shawbury are inconsistent and mid-table. Crewe make another appearance, facing New Mills away on the same evening.
